meta.title: Chris Opon-Nimoh
meta.description: Chris Opon-Nimoh is a technology leader, builder, and CTO at Smart.pr.

intro.heading: Building useful things
intro.description: I’m Chris Opon-Nimoh, currently CTO at Smart.pr. I love technology, software, and the process of turning an idea into something people can use.

items.heading: Building
items.description: Apps, companies and even furniture. The process of an idea/potential crystallizing into reality. Something I can never get enough of.

items.heading: Thinking in systems
items.description: I like getting to the root of a problem, keeping the long view in mind, and making practical choices along the way.

items.heading: Staying curious
items.description: The web is a great place to play, experiment, learn quickly, and see what happens when you make things.

latestPosts.heading: Notes along the way
latestPosts.empty: Something new is on its way.
